name: Reachy Mini
description: Peer agent bridge between OpenClaw and Reachy Mini robot. Shares voice context with OpenClaw, forwards research findings to Reachy.

reachyUrl.description: Base URL of the Reachy bridge API (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8100)

apiSecret.description: Shared secret for bridge API auth (must match REACHY_BRIDGE_SECRET)

forwardMessages.description: Enable message forwarding between OpenClaw and Reachy

transcriptChannels.description: Channels to forward robot transcripts to (e.g. ['discord:123456'])

extractLinks.description: Fetch and inject link content (two-phase injection)

linkMaxChars.description: Max characters to extract from links

forwardAgentResponse.description: Forward OpenClaw's processed agent response to Reachy (via message_sending hook)

notifyOnReceive.description: Send Reachy a brief notification when a Discord message arrives

taskWebhookUrl.description: Discord webhook URL for posting tasks from Reachy (posts as a different user so the bot processes it)

taskChannelId.description: Discord channel ID where tasks should be posted (for sendMessage fallback when no webhook is configured)
